title: Staying with Tony and the risque songs of the day
summary: Williams recalls long stays with Tony and the risque novelty songs he sang, such as Who Ate Nelly and Hot Nuts.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: I stayed one time with Tony for thirteen months, second time eleven months. I was really here two years with him. We drank up here, and we used to talk. Tony was a good entertainer. I was. He used to sing risque songs. Nothing dirty, no fault of the words.
